summary: Test suite has strong TDD structure and excellent workflow validation through act. Unit tests thoroughly cover happy paths (parsing, aggregation, markdown generation, CLI) with clear fixtures and good organization. However, significant gaps exist: (1) Bare `<testsuite>` root mentioned in docstring but never tested; (2) Error conditions largely untested (malformed XML/JSON, invalid status values, missing required fields); (3) No tests for edge cases (special characters in test names, case-insensitive extensions, duplicate test names, tests appearing in only some files); (4) Status alias normalization tested for JSON but not XML. The act workflow harness is well-designed with parametrized cases and exact output assertions, validating both structure (actionlint, job dependencies) and execution. Would catch most regressions in happy path but could miss bugs in error handling and unusual input variations.
